title: DAY 3 - LEGS, SIX-PACK CORE & POSTURE
subtitle: First leg session after a 1-year layoff. Strict "Zero-Glute" biomechanics applied. Acclimatization protocol: stop all sets at 2–3 RIR to prevent crippling DOMS while establishing clean baseline numbers.

instructions.title: 1. Recommended Session Flow & Sequencing Rationale
items: Follow this 1 $\rightarrow$ 7 order if machines are free. If a machine is taken, feel free to swap (e.g. Leg Curl or Extension first as pre-exhaustion) and just mention the swap when you log:
1. **Leg Press**: Primary heavy compound. Needs maximum fresh CNS energy and knee stability.
2. **Leg Extension**: Pure quad pump. Knees are hot and lubricated from pressing.
3. **Leg Curl**: Antagonist hamstring balance. Normalizes patellar tendon pressure after quad volume.
4. **Calf Raise**: Peripheral isolation. Gives systemic breathing recovery before abdominal work.
5. **Cable Crunch**: Heavy mechanical tension for six-pack hypertrophy while core is fresh.
6. **Deadbugs / Knee Raise**: Deep transverse abdominis & posterior pelvic tilt bracing.
7. **Hip Flexor Stretch**: Post-workout psoas release. Stretching warm muscles produces lasting postural change.

instructions.title: 2. Dynamic Warm-Up Protocol (5–7 Mins)
items: **Step 1: Light Cardio**: 3–5 minutes on treadmill (incline walk) or stationary bike to circulate synovial fluid in knees.
**Step 2: Leg Swings**: 15 reps front-to-back & 15 reps side-to-side per leg (loosens tight hip capsules).
**Step 3: Ankle Mobility**: 15 rocks per ankle against wall (primes dorsiflexion so knees track forward smoothly over toes).
**Step 4: Specific Sets**: Empty sled $\times$ 12, Sled + 20kg $\times$ 8 directly on Leg Press before loading working weight.

instructions.title: 3. 1-Year Layoff Safety Ceiling: 2–3 RIR
items: **Do NOT train to muscular failure (0 RIR) today.** Eccentric muscle trauma on deconditioned legs causes extreme DOMS that can cripple you for 5 days.
Leave **2 to 3 clean reps in reserve (2–3 RIR)** on every working set today. Treat this as an Acclimatization & Baseline Calibration session.

instructions.title: 4. The "Zero-Glutes" Biomechanical Guardrail
items: 9 hours of daily desk sitting causes shortened hip flexors (psoas) and Anterior Pelvic Tilt (APT), pushing glutes outward and protruding the lower belly.
Standard leg exercises (squats, RDLs, hip thrusts, lunges) hyper-develop the gluteus maximus, widening the hips and worsening the feminine pear shape.
Today's session uses 0 squats, 0 RDLs, 0 hip thrusts. We load pure quad sweep and knee flexion only.

instructions.title: 5. Six-Pack & Core Execution Protocol
items: For six-pack bricks: Kneeling cable crunches require curling the ribcage toward the pelvis, NOT hip hinging.
For flat lower belly & APT reversal: Deadbugs require keeping the lower back glued 100% flat to the floor to brace the transverse abdominis.

exercises.mmc: Don't just push the platform up with your hips. Think about *pushing the floor away with your mid-foot while driving your knees outward over your second toe*. Stop strictly when knees hit 90°—if you go deeper, your pelvis tucks under ('butt wink'), turning off your quads and overloading your lower spine. Keep hips glued flat. exercises.cue: Pure knee flexion (0% hip extension / zero glutes). Slow 3s eccentric return.

Never arch your lower back to yank the pad down.

exercises.swap_option: Can be done anytime a machine is open or between leg sets.

exercises.target: **3 sets x 12–15 reps** | Rest: 60 sec | Target RIR: **1–2**
exercises.cue: Lock hips fixed at 90°. Roll spine into a ball, curling ribs down into pelvis. Squeeze abs for 1s.

exercises.target: **3 sets x 12–15 reps** | Rest: 60 sec | Target RIR: **1**

Slowly extend opposite arm and leg while pulling your tailbone slightly up into a posterior pelvic tilt. If your lower back arches even 1 millimeter, stop the rep immediately. In the half-kneeling position, tuck your tailbone under like a dog tucking its tail, and **actively squeeze the glute of the trailing back leg as hard as possible**. You will instantly feel a sharp, targeted release in the front crease of your hip pocket. Hold and breathe deeply into your belly for 60 seconds per leg.

### 2. Leg Extension Machine
